kind: Object integrity levels with bounded own-property snapshots

record.kind: Independent bounded static review of initial Object integrity implementation
scope: existing property/key/array helpers and affected descriptor routes
record.overall: No concrete semantic, panic, invariant or resource-containment defect found in this bounded static review of supported targets. This is not execution evidence or a full security/conformance assessment.

planning_finding_resolution.evidence: integrity_flags borrows the property record and reads only configurable/data-writable bits; virtual string indices return immutable flags directly. It does not call own_property, fetch mapped values or allocate one-unit strings. Definitions occur only when flags need change, so immutable virtual string data never reaches the allocating definition read.

ordinary_define_own_key no longer clones parameter_map tuples. It borrows the mapping after property insertion, which does not mutate parameter_map, then optionally updates the environment and detaches mapping. integrity_define additionally charges work proportional to actual binding-name UTF-8 length and environment size before the mapped descriptor read.

integrity_keys computes a bound from stored order, cached dense elements and virtual string length. It charges work and base/vector/numeric-key heap allowance before materialization, then uses try_reserve_exact. Tuple sorting is in-place with explicit ordinal ties; no stable-sort buffer or BTreeSet deduplication is used. The old own_keys helper remains unchanged outside this scope.

The needs_change predicate skips already immutable virtual strings and other compatible unchanged flags on the supported nontrapping targets. This avoids creating redundant virtual-string property records. This optimization must not be generalized to Proxy or host definition traps without observable-operation handling.

The entry tick precedes effects; supported mutators set non_extensible before taking the snapshot. Each later budget/definition error returns without rollback. Extensible queries return false before key allocation. Definitions use document-aware define_property_key and false becomes TypeError. No accessor getter or prototype walk is used.

semantic_review.result: All primitive values follow identity/true fast paths without ToObject. property_object admission is checked before host sidecars could be mutated. Ordinary objects with host prototypes remain supported because only own keys/flags are used. Window/Document/DOM/CSSOM/Console variants are explicitly unsupported.

Virtual indices and cached dense entries omit indices with stored overrides; stored keys are then included once from unique creation order. Dense holes are skipped, while present sidecar entries still come from order. One virtual length key replaces any stored length occurrence. Tuple kind orders array indices, other strings, then symbols; index and original ordinal preserve numeric/chronological order. Canonical u32 indices exclude 4294967295, leading-zero strings and -0. Long/non-scalar string keys remain identity-preserving borrowed Rc values.

Actual pushed entries cannot exceed the pre-reserved bound under valid arena invariants. Logical array gaps are not enumerated. Dense-cache holes still contribute conservative work/storage accounting. Numeric string scratch has a bounded digit count under cached-array/string limits. Sorting compares numeric tuple components, not arbitrary key contents, and key flags separately precharge length-sensitive map lookup.

isSealed tests configurable; isFrozen additionally tests writable data. Accessors count only configurability, so a frozen object may retain functioning setters. The entire own-key snapshot precedes any descriptor short-circuit, while an extensible object exits before snapshot. No getters, coercion hooks, prototypes, children or callback code are visited.

Seal changes only configurable. Freeze adds writable:false only for data descriptors; accessor/data kind is not accidentally changed. Attribute-only array length follows array_set_length without conversions or deletion. Dense values transition to descriptor sidecars through validated definitions; existing sidecars win over dense cache. Sealed length can remain writable and grow across holes; frozen length becomes readonly.

The existing current-descriptor read observes live parameter binding before freezing. Property insertion precedes alias detachment. Seal leaves writable mappings attached; freeze detaches only successfully processed mapped keys. Borrowing the mapping after insertion preserves the earlier explicit-value update semantics for other ordinary definitions and avoids the variable-sized name clone.

Skipping already nonconfigurable sealed properties, and already nonconfigurable readonly frozen data, is equivalent for supported nontrapping ordinary/array/string targets. A valid mapped property cannot remain mapped after a completed writable:false definition. Virtual string indices already have the immutable flags being requested. Missing snapshot descriptors cannot arise through author code during these callback-free loops.

Function/native property bags are covered without affecting private call/construct identity. Freezing remains shallow. RegExp lastIndex flows through ordinary flags and existing strict reference writes. Array reverse and sort already perform strict live writes/deletes; neither bypasses the new flags. Splice is absent, not implemented through an unchecked dense path.

All four methods are registered through intrinsic_function with arity one and normal constructor-property metadata. Exact internal names dispatch at the beginning of native_call, before generic argument/receiver content scanning; author changes to public method name or aliases do not change dispatch. Ordinary call and argument-evaluation costs still apply, so this is not a claim that every public primitive invocation is allocation-free.

resource_review.snapshot_preflight: work = 1 + bound * (4 * (1 + floor(log2(bound)))) with saturating bound products; heap = 64 + bound * size_of(IntegrityKey) + virtual_indices * 128. Work and cumulative heap charges precede key Vec reservation and numeric key construction.
resource_review.per_key: Flag lookups precharge actual key bytes times property-map logarithm. Needed definitions charge mapped binding comparisons when applicable, then 128 bytes of scratch before the document-aware definition helper; new descriptor records retain their separate existing charge.
resource_review.failure_order: A rejected entry tick leaves state unchanged. After the mutator marks nonextensible, snapshot or descriptor refusal preserves that flag and any completed definitions. Failed reservations or charges do not fabricate successful integrity. Queries do not mutate target flags.
resource_review.bounds_caveat: Arithmetic reasoning assumes valid Runtime arenas constructed through existing capped APIs. The loop does not recursively walk object graphs; no invalid-arena-ID fuzzing or allocator/driver claims are made.

private_test_targets_sent_to_owner: Mixed canonical/noncanonical string and symbol key ordering, with dense sidecar overrides, dense holes with present sidecars, and previously materialized immutable boxed-string index/length; require each own key once.
Exhausted-work entry before any mutation; snapshot heap/work failure after nonextensible commits; compare flags and arena state directly.
Stop a freeze between two descriptor writes; verify only visited flags/mapped aliases change and array length/holes/sidecars remain valid.
Long mapped argument binding name versus a short numeric key: work refusal precedes defining/detaching that argument and no name-sized allocation remains.
Extensible query with exhausted heap returns false without key/value allocation; primitive direct-helper behavior likewise remains distinct from ordinary public-call overhead.
Repeated boxed-string seal/freeze/queries must not materialize virtual immutable property records or invoke coercion/accessor hooks.
Huge logical sparse arrays with identical occupied entries should not incur cost proportional to logical length; valid prototype cycles are irrelevant to own-key integrity.
Earlier author effects and terminal resource behavior survive normal continuation/frame cleanup; runtime counters return to their entry boundaries.

tests_reported_by_owner_not_reexecuted.qualification: Parent-reported initial candidate observations only; this review independently ran no engine or tests. Private tests were still being authored during inspection.

record.review_limits: No production edits, Cargo/build, engine execution, native windows, GPU work or baseline changes. Scope is the initial source hashes above. New private tests, later formatting changes and final release provenance require their own attribution; this report does not claim complete ECMAScript, all allocation paths audited, production security or benchmark performance.

format_delta.parent_attribution: Core formatting only plus cfg(test) module registration; no production semantic edits reported.
format_delta.independent_check: Re-read the complete formatted integrity module and matched dispatch, key snapshot/precharge, flag-only lookup, operation ordering, compatible-flag fast paths and mapped-definition behavior against the retained initial review. No semantic delta found. The original full module bytes were not retained by this reviewer, so this is not a claimed token-diff proof.

private_test_review: The unchanged local fixture loader runs all 114 cases in strict and sloppy modes after unchanged upstream helpers, asserts successful completion and machine-state cleanup, and requires exactly 228 modes.

Primitive and extensible-query controls use exactly one helper tick at exhausted heap, check arena stability and avoid accidental ordinary-call frame costs; long non-scalar strings and poison accessors distinguish real fast paths.
Native dispatch tests prebuilt ignored arguments separately from public argument evaluation, proving entry quota is shared and content scans are bypassed only for ignored values.
Entry/work/heap snapshot failures distinguish unchanged extensibility from completed PreventExtensions and inspect descriptors/mappings/arenas without resetting execute budgets.

Partial array and mapped-arguments tests measure real prefix costs on separate runtimes, then inspect exact first-property progress, later untouched flags, sidecar/dense consistency, length, holes and live versus detached parameter aliases.

Key-order expectations are independent explicit sequences covering dense overrides, holes with accessors, u32 boundary/noncanonical keys, deleted/readded string and symbol creation order, plus materialized boxed-string index/length duplicates.
Boxed-string tests inspect immutable virtual flags at exhausted heap and admit only the measured snapshot budget, requiring no synthetic descriptor records after all four operations.
Identical stored sparse shapes at lengths 16, 65536 and u32::MAX must have equal work/heap costs; a high-index shape also completes under a fixed small allowance.
Mapped-name tests cover 1, 257 and 4097 byte names, increasing comparison work without name-sized allocation; work refusal preserves the unvisited mapping and later parameter updates remain visible.

Host tests cover existing symbol sidecars on Window/Document/Node/Style/ClassList/Console and require rejection before mutation at exhausted heap. Valid-arena host and cyclic prototypes do not affect ordinary own-property operations.
Repeated public operations demonstrate terminal resource errors preserve prior effects, skip author catch/finally and unwind call/stack/frame/join guards.
record.execution_attribution: Parent reports all 15 focused groups pass; this reviewer executed no Rust or adapter tests.

observations: Each added control requires the selected intrinsic to exist and successfully invokes it before any negative assertion. Mutating guards verify identity, nonextensibility and flags; predicate guards check both false and true.

Mapped arguments use Function-created sloppy bodies in both outer modes. Mutator expectation distinguishes seal alias retention from freeze snapshot/detachment; predicate controls independently assert the retained alias.
Unmapped arguments use explicit strict function bodies. Frozen writes are required to throw while sealed writes preserve the unaliased parameter.
Metadata checks use restore:true for Object method, length and name descriptors. The property-metadata case name selects unchanged propertyHelper.js via existing include routing.
Positive/wrong partners preserve setup and differ in the final SameValue expectation. Both modes retain the paired controls.
Failed partners verify only Test262Error, so incidental TypeError/RangeError/ReferenceError/SyntaxError cannot satisfy them. All controls completing or all failing cannot validate the full profile.
Feature policy does not exclude older untagged unavailable Date/Map/Proxy/typed-array cases; tests require they stay admitted and observed. Metadata-excluded cases remain in the complete inventory.

limits: The complete 239-source selection has 378 passed, 58 missing-global failures and 38 unsupported modes. All source/mode/harness/policy and preflight fingerprints are preserved.

The 38 unsupported modes consist of 26 metadata exclusions, eight unchanged parser observations and four newly reached host-object observations. They remain distinct from passes.

All 228 independently frozen local modes pass unchanged, with all 12 assertion controls verified. New upstream controls verify 224/224 after and 128/224 before; all 96 positive method guards failed before implementation.
Integrity operations cover the supported ordinary objects, arrays and boxed strings. Proxy, broader host objects, typed arrays and cross-realm behavior remain incomplete.

Key snapshots precharge work and temporary storage, reserve checked capacity and sort in place. Flag reads do not allocate virtual string values or read mapped parameter values. Actual changes use shared descriptor validation; nonextensibility and earlier property changes persist under later resource refusal.

The shared property definition no longer clones mapped binding names. Integrity definitions charge comparison work by the actual binding name; unchanged flag definitions avoid unnecessary boxed-string property materialization.

No work, heap, recursion quota or process authority was increased. Bounded source/tooling review and local tests are not a whole-engine security audit. No GPU exercise or Chromium performance comparison was performed.
